blocks.text: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — The United Arab Emirates announced Thursday that it was investigating a possible “terrorist” link to an apparent attack by a co-pilot on a flight to Israel, after passengers intervened to prevent the plane from crashing. The dramatic events on Wednesday ended with passengers receiving a hero’s welcome from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu upon their return to Israel from Saudi Arabia, where the plane had made an emergency landing hours earlier. Netanyahu credited flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar, an Indian national, and the passengers with averting a catastrophe after a co-pilot allegedly stabbed the pilot and tried to […]...
